_comment: v4rian dev required status checks, required for any PR merge to dev. The required.* contexts (required.commit-audit, required.compile, required.coverage, required.runtime, required.offline-test-suites) are emitted by .github/workflows/ci-dispatch.yml on the PUSH trigger and match the required.*.sh basenames (minus .sh) under .io.v4rian.neo-git/ci/{tests,audits}/push/ - they run when commits are pushed to a pool branch; the PR itself does not re-run them but REUSES the push results by head SHA (GitHub attaches the existing commit statuses to the PR). The 'reconcile' context is NOT a required.*.sh file: it is seeded by .io.v4rian.neo-git/scripts/validate-pr-open.sh and resolved per outcome by .io.v4rian.neo-git/scripts/auto-rebase-pools-after-dev-merge.sh. Applied via .io.v4rian.neo-git/scripts/apply-repo-rules.sh, which folds these contexts into the dev branch protection rule. The check names MUST match the matrix job 'name:' fields in ci-dispatch.yml verbatim; GitHub matches required checks by exact string.
name: v4rian-dev-required-checks
